selection_criterion: lexicographic (macro_f1, mcc, accuracy) on validation only
refit_policy: train + validation with selected hyperparameters (test never used for selection)
confidence_derivation: softmax(decision_function) — NOT a calibrated probability. LinearSVC has no predict_proba; this is a monotonic transform of the signed distance to the separating hyperplane, scaled to sum to 1 across classes for reporting convenience only.
